# S1 — generated by score6502.py

Uniform byte partners and counts follow the frozen DZ scorer: top tapes culture-tested over 64 partners; 16 traced encounters; final 64 cells culture-tested over 32 shared partners; up to 16 heritable cells scanned (16 alternatives per site, 16 partners). Classes use the frozen population estimator. Offset equality uses the scanned heritable confined cells with measured d ≥ 6.

Loop calls use identical-pair PC prefix replays through the world's executor. Closure is strict for P2: tapes at t_closed do not count. Null P1–P3 means not tested. KM medians follow dial_soups; 'censored' means the median was not reached.
